name: Barth症候群

summary.text: Barth syndrome (BTHS) is an inborn error of phospholipid metabolism characterized by dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM), skeletal myopathy, neutropenia, growth delay and organic aciduria.
summary.evidence: Barth syndrome (BTHS) is an inborn error
